A8 round 3 is complete. **No items edited** — zero `confirmed_fatal`, so nothing to rejudge and A8 closes immediately.

## Rulings

| # | item | model | ruling |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `cex-cauchy-rationals-no-rational-limit` | deepseek | **false_positive** (4th) |
| 2 | `cex-strictly-decreasing-gaps-no-limit` | deepseek | confirmed_nonfatal |

Evidence, one line each:
1. `fs-rationals-complete` has a full Refutation establishing every `[L1]` clause verbatim — *"set $s_n = k_n/10^n$; then $s_n^2 \le 2 < (s_n+10^{-n})^2$"*, *"$(s_n)$ is Cauchy"*, *"no rational limit"*. The judge read the refuted claim as the page's whole content.
2. `lem-power-monotone` supplies `[L3]`'s other clause exactly; the binomial identity is distributivity, and step 2.2 co-cites `[L1]` ordered-field arithmetic.
3. `lem-of-abs-value` states *"$-|x| \le x \le |x|$"* verbatim, and step 1.2 uses only the forward direction off that chain.
4. The clause is `def-abs-value`'s first branch and appears verbatim as `[L1]` *inside* the cited `lem-of-abs-value`.
5. Three of four `[L5]` clauses are verbatim; the fourth is one case split on $|t| \in \{t,-t\}$, and step 4.1 already co-cites `[L9]` trichotomy.
6. The Remark does **not** assert a converse the library lacks — `thm-cauchy-criterion-via-lub` *is* the library's Cauchy⇒convergent and is named in the same parenthetical doing all the work. `lem-convergent-implies-cauchy` is mis-slotted, doing none.

**Twice-touched:** `cor-monotone-converges-iff-bounded` — escalated to your personal audit per the standing rule; ruled nonfatal, no fix. Against my round-2 stopping condition (a third distinct *fatal* reopens the Statement), a third nonfatal does not.

## Two things to correct on your side

**The dispatch's item hashes were the wrong normalisation.** All six came from `judge.mts`'s hash (only the `judge:` sub-block stripped); the adjudication ledger is consumed by `step8-guard`, which compares against `item-hash.mjs` (whole `verification:` block stripped). Copying them in would have written rows the guard can never match. The derived claim was also false: `cex-cauchy-rationals-no-rational-limit` has **not** changed — its normalised hash is still `beede7a2a1…`, identical to all three prior `false_positive` rows. Same for four of the other five. The apparent movement was a judge stamp.

**A concurrent process edited `library/topology/function-space-topologies.md` at 03:08:30, inside my window.** Not mine — I made no write under `library/` or `items/`. It looks like a correct published-claim-decay prose fix, and I left it in place. But note `step8-guard` tracks `items/` only, so a `library/` page edit passes R1 silently even though R1's text forbids page mutation at A8. It did not stale the receipt: my gate run at 03:09:44 came after it and still returned 209/209, because clause (b) of commit `3bbae7f` covered every item on the page — first live confirmation that fix works, worth ~31 rejudge calls.
